configuration.passage: heading + newline + content, same as production embeddingText
configuration.tuning: One preselected configuration; no tuning on either split.

measurement.timing: Tokenization, padding, CPU inference, sorting and quota selection for 30 frozen candidates; excludes initial retrieval, model loading and per-worker warmup.
measurement.baselineTiming: Quota selection over already ranked RRF candidates; not total retrieval latency.
measurement.labels: Original chapter and exact-quote labels; alternative unjudged evidence is not added.
measurement.warmup: One complete 30-pair query per worker, excluded from measurements.
measurement.noAnswer: Nonempty retrieval is not an answer-generation error rate.

pairedRecallDelta.unit: question; this interval does not model correlation within source families
